Find the perimeter of an equilateral triangle with a side length of 14 cm. [10-20 words]
questions.answer: Since an equilateral triangle has three equal sides, its perimeter is 3 multiplied by 14 cm, giving exactly 42 cm.

questions.question_text: Add the fractions 1/4 and 2/4, and simplify your answer. [15-25 words]
questions.answer: Adding the numerators over the common denominator gives 3/4. Since 3 and 4 have no common factors, 3/4 is already in its simplest form.

questions.question_text: Write the integer that represents withdrawing 500 rupees from a bank account. [10-20 words]
questions.answer: A withdrawal decreases the balance, so it is represented by the negative integer -500.

questions.question_text: State the number of lines of symmetry for a rectangle. [10-20 words]
questions.answer: A rectangle has exactly two lines of symmetry: one horizontal and one vertical, intersecting at the center.

questions.question_text: Calculate the area of a rectangle measuring 9 cm by 5 cm. [10-20 words]
questions.answer: The area is length multiplied by breadth, which is 9 cm times 5 cm, resulting in 45 sq cm.

questions.question_text: Arrange the following integers in ascending order: 3, -4, 0, -1, 5. [10-20 words]
questions.answer: Arranging from smallest to largest, the ascending order is: -4, -1, 0, 3, 5.

questions.question_text: A submarine is at a depth of 250 meters below sea level. It descends a further 120 meters. Express its new position as an integer. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The initial position is -250 meters. Descending further means we subtract 120. So, -250 minus 120 equals -370. The new position is 370 meters below sea level, represented by the integer -370.

questions.question_text: Maya bought 3/8 meters of blue ribbon and 2/8 meters of red ribbon. Find the total length of ribbon she bought. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Since the denominators are the same, we add the numerators: 3 plus 2 equals 5. Thus, she bought a total of 5/8 meters of ribbon.

questions.question_text: Determine the cost of fencing a square park of side 150 m at the rate of Rs 20 per meter. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: First, find the perimeter: 4 multiplied by 150 m equals 600 m. Next, multiply the perimeter by the rate. 600 m times Rs 20 gives a total fencing cost of Rs 12,000.

questions.question_text: Using a ruler and compass, describe briefly the two main steps to draw a perpendicular bisector of a line segment AB. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: First, place the compass on point A and draw arcs above and below the line with a radius greater than half of AB. Second, repeat from point B without changing the radius, then draw a straight line connecting the intersection points.

questions.question_text: Subtract 3/5 from 4/5 and multiply the result by 2. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: First, subtracting 3/5 from 4/5 leaves 1/5. Next, multiplying 1/5 by 2 yields 2/5 as the final answer.

questions.question_text: A room has a rectangular floor 8 m long and 6 m wide. A carpet covers exactly 3/4 of this floor. Calculate the area covered by the carpet. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The total floor area is 8 m multiplied by 6 m, which is 48 sq m. To find the carpet's area, calculate 3/4 of 48. Divide 48 by 4 to get 12, then multiply by 3 to get exactly 36 sq m.

questions.question_text: Draw a number line (mentally) and calculate the distance between the integers -7 and 4. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To find the distance, subtract the smaller integer from the larger one: 4 minus (-7) becomes 4 plus 7, which equals 11 units.

questions.question_text: Identify which two letters of the word 'MATH' have a vertical line of symmetry, and explain why. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The letters M, A, and T all have vertical lines of symmetry because folding them down the vertical center creates two identical mirror halves. The letter H has both vertical and horizontal symmetry.

questions.question_text: A rectangular garden is 45 meters long and 30 meters wide. A 2-meter wide path is built all around the outside of the garden. Calculate the total area of the path alone. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, calculate the inner garden area: 45 multiplied by 30 equals 1350 sq m. The new outer length is 45 plus 2 plus 2 (49 m), and the outer width is 30 plus 2 plus 2 (34 m). The outer area is 49 times 34, which is 1666 sq m. Finally, subtract the inner area from the outer area (1666 minus 1350) to find the path area, which is 316 sq m.

questions.question_text: Raju read 1/3 of a 300-page book on Monday and 1/4 of the remaining pages on Tuesday. Calculate the exact number of pages he has left to read. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: On Monday, Raju read 1/3 of 300, which is 100 pages, leaving 200 pages. On Tuesday, he read 1/4 of the remaining 200 pages, which is 50 pages. In total, he read 100 plus 50, equaling 150 pages. Subtracting this from 300 leaves exactly 150 pages still to read.

questions.question_text: Evaluate the expression: (-15) + 24 - (-10) + (-5) showing step-by-step simplification using integer rules. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, handle the double negative: -(-10) becomes +10. The expression is now -15 + 24 + 10 - 5. Adding the positive numbers (24 + 10) gives 34. Adding the negative numbers (-15 - 5) gives -20. Finally, combine them: 34 minus 20 equals exactly 14.

questions.question_text: Describe the complete construction steps to draw a circle of radius 4 cm and mark a chord of length 5 cm inside it using a ruler and compass. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Step 1: Open the compass to exactly 4 cm using a ruler. Step 2: Mark a center point O and draw the circle. Step 3: Mark any point A on the circumference. Step 4: Open the compass to 5 cm. Place the needle on A and cut an arc on the circle's edge at point B. Step 5: Draw a straight line connecting A and B to form the 5 cm chord.
